item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"feed:https://www.onshape.com/en/blog/ai-generated-thumbnail-description-search","version_id":"b2755a997c3cdda71421bbdd40ee9721d353cbc20ed2f1f80e91169757b9bbd2","decision":"accept","reason":"Relevant, fresh commercial CAD evidence: Onshape says its October 5 Labs feature generates searchable descriptions from static model thumbnails, allowing natural-language discovery of public-document parts. The claim is checkable at the feature level through the opt-in public-documents release, but the source does not show that thumbnail-based descriptions preserve dimensions, manufacturability, or reliable geometric identity; its claims about reducing duplicate designs and internal/supplier use are explicitly speculative. This supplies an attributed vendor perspective and a useful distinction between visual retrieval and verified engineering geometry.","piece_ids":["01","02","03"]}
